description: Moves or renames a file or folder within the matter's Dropbox folder. Does not overwrite or delete. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

from.description: Current path, relative to the matter folder.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

to.description: New path, relative to the matter folder.

name: move_dropbox_file
title: Move Dropbox file
